description: This file defines the LayoutManager class and related buffer structures for managing memory layout in the torch::nativert namespace, including functions for allocation, deallocation, and sanity checks.

classes.name: ContiguousLayoutBuffer
classes.description: Manages a contiguous memory buffer with allocation, deallocation, and offset calculations.

classes.name: ContiguousStorageImplBuffer
classes.description: Manages an array of StorageImpl objects with dynamic allocation and reset capabilities.

classes.name: LayoutManager
classes.description: Handles memory layout planning, allocation, and sanity checks for tensor storage in the nativert executor.

classes.name: LayoutManagerGuard
classes.description: RAII guard for automatic allocation and deallocation of LayoutManager.

methods.name: get_offset_from_ptr
methods.description: Calculates the offset of a pointer within the buffer.

methods.name: get_ptr_with_offset
methods.description: Returns a pointer offset within the buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears a portion of the buffer.

methods.name: reset_all
methods.description: Resets all StorageImpl objects in the buffer.

methods.name: to_managed
methods.description: Converts a StorageImpl to a managed version within the buffer.

methods.name: deallocate_and_plan
methods.description: Deallocates current layout and plans new layout.

methods.name: assert_no_overlapping_storages
methods.description: Sanity check for overlapping storage regions.
